# pve_cluster_resources (Data Source)

Lists every resource in the Proxmox VE cluster (nodes, storages, pools, guests, and SDN entities) as reported by `GET /cluster/resources`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every resource in the Proxmox VE cluster.

data "pve_cluster_resources" "all" {}

output "running_guests" {
  value = [for r in data.pve_cluster_resources.all.resources : r.id if r.status == "running"]
}

# Only guest resources, filtered server-side.

data "pve_cluster_resources" "vms" {
  type = "vm"
}

output "vmids" {
  value = [for r in data.pve_cluster_resources.vms.resources : r.vmid]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Optional server-side filter by resource type. Must be one of: `vm`, `storage`, `node`, `sdn`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for the cluster resource index.
- `resources` (Attributes List) Cluster resources matching the filter (or all resources when no filter is set). Fields that PVE omits for a given resource type are empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `cgroup_mode` (Number) The cgroup mode the node operates under (for type `node`).
- `content` (String) Allowed storage content types (for type `storage`).
- `cpu` (Number) CPU utilization (for types `node`, `qemu`, and `lxc`).
- `disk` (Number) Used disk space in bytes (for type `storage`), used root image space for guests (for types `qemu` and `lxc`).
- `diskread` (Number) Bytes the guest read from its block devices since start (for types `qemu` and `lxc`).
- `diskwrite` (Number) Bytes the guest wrote to its block devices since start (for types `qemu` and `lxc`).
- `hastate` (String) HA service status (for HA-managed guests).
- `host_arch` (String) The node's CPU architecture: `x86_64` or `aarch64` (for type `node`).
- `id` (String) Resource ID.
- `level` (String) Support level (for type `node`).
- `lock` (String) The guest's current config lock (for types `qemu` and `lxc`).
- `maxcpu` (Number) Number of available CPUs (for types `node`, `qemu`, and `lxc`).
- `maxdisk` (Number) Storage size in bytes (for type `storage`), root image size for guests (for types `qemu` and `lxc`).
- `maxmem` (Number) Available memory in bytes (for types `node`, `qemu`, and `lxc`).
- `mem` (Number) Used memory in bytes (for types `node`, `qemu`, and `lxc`).
- `memhost` (Number) Used memory in bytes from the host's point of view (for type `qemu`).
- `name` (String) Name of the resource.
- `netin` (Number) Traffic in bytes sent to the guest over the network since start (for types `qemu` and `lxc`).
- `netout` (Number) Traffic in bytes sent from the guest over the network since start (for types `qemu` and `lxc`).
- `network` (String) Name of a network entity (for type `network`).
- `network_type` (String) Type of network resource: `fabric` or `zone` (for type `network`).
- `node` (String) The cluster node name (for types `node`, `storage`, `qemu`, and `lxc`).
- `plugintype` (String) More specific type, if available.
- `pool` (String) The pool name (for types `pool`, `qemu`, and `lxc`).
- `protocol` (String) Protocol of a fabric (for type `network`, network_type `fabric`).
- `sdn` (String) Name of an SDN entity (for type `sdn`).
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the storage is shared (for type `storage`).
- `status` (String) Resource type dependent status.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier (for type `storage`).
- `tags` (String) The guest's tags (for types `qemu` and `lxc`).
- `template` (Boolean) Whether the guest is a template (for types `qemu` and `lxc`).
- `type` (String) Resource type: `node`, `storage`, `pool`, `qemu`, `lxc`, `openvz`, `sdn`, or `network`.
- `uptime` (Number) Uptime of node or guest in seconds (for types `node`, `qemu`, and `lxc`).
- `vmid` (Number) The numerical VM ID (for types `qemu` and `lxc`).
- `zone_type` (String) The type of an SDN zone (for type `sdn`).
